change: vs 028: noisy-half rows use the mean of 4 D4 views (id, T, UD, R90) of the ft-a1s250 segmenter, plus 16 columns = across-view std of key grain features (segmentation/feature-extraction variability indicator; NaN for clean-half rows). Same TabPFN v2+v3.5 mean, same fixed W=0.75.
dev_note: 4-view mean alone (no std columns) was worse on dev with v3.5 (pooled 10.992 vs 10.893), so the gain comes with the std columns; harness/dev differences < ~0.1 are near evaluation noise.
weight_rule: fixed W=0.75 (pre-fixed after the 2026-10-08 review; no data-driven weight selection)

inputs.vstd_definition: np.nanstd over the 4 D4 views (id, T, UD, R90) of each key feature, noisy-half rows only (NaN elsewhere); a segmentation/feature-extraction variability indicator, not a validated hardness uncertainty

harness_note: harness numbers come from eval_concat.py (v2 n_est 8 seed 0 / v3.5 default) on features-v3 + noisy rows from ftseg-ft-a1s250-train-noisy-n4.npz + the same 16 vstd columns
